author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical workspace propagation. Canonical mail-client params structs (EmailGetParams, MailboxSetParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams, EmailParseParams, EmailCopyParams, EmailImportInput) all derive only (Debug, Default, Serialize) — Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash are all absent. Adding Clone (+ PartialEq?) requires the canonical-template change to land first. Loosely tracked behind JMAP-tjvm.16 (the canonical #[non_exhaustive] bead also touches the same set of structs and would be the natural moment to add Clone too).
